description_en: Queries the price of a cluster
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-db-cluster-price --order-type BUY --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterPrice

parameters.help_en: The node specifications. Required for the BUY scenario. Example format: polar.mysql.x4.large
parameters.help_zh: 节点规格。BUY场景必填，格式如polar.mysql.x4.large
parameters.name: db_node_class

parameters.help_en: The database engine type. Required for the BUY scenario. Valid values: MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle
parameters.help_zh: 数据库引擎类型。BUY场景必填，取值：MySQL、PostgreSQL、Oracle
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The database engine version. Required for the BUY scenario. Valid values for MySQL: 5.6, 5.7, and 8.0. Valid values for PostgreSQL: 11 and 14. Valid values for Oracle: 11 and 14
parameters.help_zh: 数据库引擎版本。BUY场景必填。MySQL取值：5.6、5.7、8.0；PostgreSQL取值：11、14；Oracle取值：11、14
parameters.name: db_version

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Required for the BUY and CONVERT scenarios. Valid values:
Prepaid: subscription.
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh: 付费类型。BUY和CONVERT场景必填。取值：Prepaid（包年包月）、Postpaid（按量付费）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The order type. Valid values:
BUY: new purchase.
CONVERT: billing method conversion.
RENEW: renewal.
UPGRADE: upgrade specifications or add nodes.
DOWNGRADE: downgrade specifications or remove nodes
parameters.help_zh: 订单类型。取值：BUY（新购）、CONVERT（付费类型转换）、RENEW（续费）、UPGRADE（升配/增加节点）、DOWNGRADE（降配/删除节点）
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. We recommend that you specify this parameter for the BUY scenario
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID。BUY场景建议传入
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The number of nodes. Valid for the BUY scenario. This value includes the read/write node. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 节点数量。BUY场景有效，包含读写节点，最小值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: db_node_num

parameters.help_en:
The cluster edition. Valid values:
Normal: Cluster Edition.
Basic: Single Node Edition.
ArchiveNormal: Archive Database.
SENormal: Standard Edition.
NormalMultimaster: Multi-master Cluster
parameters.help_zh: 集群系列。取值：Normal（集群版）、Basic（单节点）、ArchiveNormal（归档版）、SENormal（标准版）、NormalMultimaster（多主集群）
parameters.name: creation_category

parameters.help_en: The storage space, in GB. Used for prepaid storage or storage specification change scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 存储空间，单位为GB。预付费存储或存储变配场景使用
parameters.name: storage_space

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values:
PSL5: high performance.
PSL4: standard.
ESSDPL0
ESSDPL1
ESSDPL2
ESSDPL3
ESSDAUTOPL
parameters.help_zh: 存储类型。取值：PSL5（高性能）、PSL4（标准）、ESSDPL0、ESSDPL1、ESSDPL2、ESSDPL3、ESSDAUTOPL
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The storage billing type. Valid values:
Prepaid: subscription.
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh: 存储计费类型。取值：Prepaid（预付费）、Postpaid（按量付费）
parameters.name: storage_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The provisioned IOPS. Used for the Standard Edition (SENormal) scenario
parameters.help_zh: 预配置IOPS。标准版（SENormal）场景使用
parameters.name: provisioned_iops

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the hot standby cluster. Valid values:
ON: Enable.
OFF: Disable.

Valid for the BUY and specification change scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启热备集群。取值：ON（开启）、OFF（关闭）。BUY场景和变更场景有效
parameters.name: hot_standby_cluster

parameters.help_en: The serverless type. Valid values: AgileServerless
parameters.help_zh: Serverless类型。取值：AgileServerless
parameters.name: serverless_type

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Required for non-BUY scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。非BUY场景必填
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration. Used together with Period. Valid for the BUY, CONVERT, and RENEW scenarios when the billing method is Prepaid
parameters.help_zh: 购买时长。与Period配合使用，BUY/CONVERT/RENEW场景且付费类型为Prepaid时有效
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The subscription cycle. Valid values:
Month: monthly.
Year: yearly
parameters.help_zh: 购买周期。取值：Month（月）、Year（年）
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The list of heterogeneous specification change nodes. Used for specification change scenarios to specify the target specifications for each node
parameters.help_zh: 异构变配节点列表。变配场景使用，指定各节点的目标规格
parameters.name: db_nodes

parameters.help_en:
The specification change direction. Valid values:
ADD: add nodes.
DELETE: remove nodes.
UPGRADE: upgrade specifications.
DOWNGRADE: downgrade specifications.
HOT_STANDBY: hot standby change.
STORAGE: storage space change.
STORAGE_TYPE: storage type change
parameters.help_zh: 变配方向。取值：ADD（增加节点）、DELETE（删除节点）、UPGRADE（升配）、DOWNGRADE（降配）、HOT_STANDBY（热备变更）、STORAGE（存储空间变配）、STORAGE_TYPE（存储类型变配）
parameters.name: modify_type

parameters.help_en: The list of node IDs to delete. Used when ModifyType is set to DELETE
parameters.help_zh: 待删除节点ID列表。ModifyType为DELETE时使用
parameters.name: db_node_ids

OrderType.description_en:
The order type. Valid values:
BUY: new purchase.
UPGRADE: specification change.
RENEW: renewal.
CONVERT: billing method conversion
OrderType.description_zh:
订单类型。取值范围如下：
BUY：新购。
UPGRADE：变更配置。
RENEW：续费。
CONVERT：转换付费类型

TradePrice.description_en: The final price, which is the original price minus the discount
TradePrice.description_zh: 最终价，为原价减去折扣
